independent_vcs_replay.status: PASS M345 independent exact-SHA M342 VCS replay

fairness_audit.reason_realized_ready_differs: mem_req_ready also depends on each run's pending-slot and response state, which diverges when K8 emits fewer bundled requests.
fairness_audit.memory_port_semantics: One global request handshake per cycle. A K8 request may activate up to eight 128-bit bank words and returns up to 1024 weight bits; a K1 request activates and returns one 128-bit bank word.
fairness_audit.service_semantics: M218 and M219 use the same O8/FIFO4/six-slice/context/result/done control skeleton. M219 is a native cropped scalar payload and adder implementation; it does not introduce a discovered extra cycle state, but it is different RTL rather than M218 parameterized to K1.
fairness_audit.interpretation: The cycle gain is preserved through connected FIFO4/O8/service/Acc24 commit under this interface, but it is coalesced eight-bank request and response-bandwidth gain, not a free packing-only gain against an eight-independent-scalar-issue baseline.

cycle_definition.start: cycle_count sampled by drive_header immediately after header_accept
cycle_definition.end: cycle_count recorded on external service token_done_accept
includes: raw frontend stalls after accepted header
cycle_definition.measurement_risk: start_cycle is sampled in a task awakened on posedge while cycle_count is updated with a blocking assignment in another posedge process. VCS replay is deterministic, but the boundary is not scheduling-race-free or frozen by one monitor/SVA counter.

protocol_and_coverage.ooo_counter_issue: It counts response_generation+1 < total accepted requests, which is also true for an ordinary older in-flight response and does not compare successive response order or prove a younger response bypassed an older due response.
protocol_and_coverage.inactive_reason: The two assertion modules are parsed from the filelist but have no bind or instance and are absent from elaborated/recompiled modules and the assertion report.
notably_uncovered_m216_paths_both_caps: terminal partial close while group releases

strongest_admissible_metric.exact_wording: Exact-SHA Synopsys VCS directed standalone raw4-to-Acc24 cycle geomean of K8 over K1 across B={1,2,4,8}, under one bundled request/cycle, eight logical 128-bit banks, L4, O8/FIFO4 and deterministic result/done stalls.

findings.title: K8 and K1 do not have equal aggregate memory request/response bandwidth
findings.evidence: Both expose eight logical banks, but the model accepts one global request per cycle. K8 reads up to eight bank words and returns up to 1024 bits in that request; K1 reads and returns one 128-bit word. Active-bank work is equal, while accepted requests are approximately 1,218 versus 8,052 across the nonzero suite.
findings.impact: The 5.2814x is a valid bundled-interface module observation but cannot be described as same-bandwidth or same-memory-resource speedup.
findings.minimum_fix: Add an equal-pin/equal-byte-per-cycle baseline such as eight independent K1 issue lanes, or charge the K8 1024-bit port with a serialized/narrow memory configuration; report area, bandwidth and energy normalization.

findings.title: M218 and M219 service assertion modules are inert
findings.evidence: Their files are parsed but neither module is bound or instantiated. VCS elaborates M342 and M216 assertions only; no M218/M219 service assertion rows appear in assert.report.
findings.impact: FIFO/outstanding bounds, response/request/context inequalities, service done-empty, service stable-under-stall and service protocol covers are not actually checked by those intended SVA modules.
findings.minimum_fix: Bind the correct parameter-specific service SVA inside each generate branch, require its nonvacuous covers, and rerun exact-SHA VCS before formal or publication admission.

findings.title: Out-of-order and exact cross-cap transaction equivalence are not directly proven
findings.evidence: The 9,262 OOO counter uses generation+1 < cumulative request count, which does not establish a response-order inversion. Active-bank equality is aggregate and numeric weights are a non-injective deterministic hash; there is no pairwise multiset hash of block/slice/bank/channel transactions.
findings.impact: The directed numeric result is strong, but required OOO coverage and exact same-active-read identity are weaker than the receipt wording.
findings.minimum_fix: Add a scoreboard proving at least one younger response is accepted before an older simultaneously eligible response, and compare K8-expanded versus K1 request tuples exactly before memory.

findings.title: Cycle endpoints are inclusive but use an active-region shared-counter race
findings.evidence: start_cycle is read by a task at header_accept while cycle_count is updated in a separate posedge block; end uses done_accept in that block and adds one. Independent VCS replay reproduces it, but IEEE scheduling does not make the task/always ordering a clean measurement contract.
findings.minimum_fix: Measure both endpoints in one clocked monitor using explicit accepted-edge counters and add N=zero/B1 directed boundary assertions.

findings.title: Several M216 corner covers are zero
findings.evidence: Both caps leave terminal-header-chain, terminal-partial-close, same-cycle done/load, descriptor-bank-sum-48 and M216-local protocol-attack covers at zero.
findings.minimum_fix: Add directed cases for each uncovered path or explicitly waive paths impossible under the M342 legal header geometry.

findings.title: Protocol/reset testing is narrow
findings.evidence: The four attacks are two illegal headers and two spurious responses; POR is asserted midflight once per cap. Malformed raw order/last, internal adapter corruption, stale-but-well-shaped identities and immediate post-reset recovery are not directly covered.
findings.minimum_fix: Extend directed protocol and recovery matrix while keeping a common POR and fail-closed adapters.

findings.title: Performance cases are synthetic and not frozen FC2 trace replay
findings.evidence: Only four nonzero deterministic shapes and one zero shape per cap are timed; no 120-record H67 FC2 trace is consumed by M342.
findings.minimum_fix: Replay the frozen 120-record cohort or export its exact group stream into the connected executor, preserving the identical memory/stall contract.

findings.title: The M342 run uses a single unsealed SHA manifest marker layer
findings.evidence: All 98 SHA256SUMS entries verify, but SHA256SUMS itself has no second-layer seal and RUN_COMPLETE.txt is written after the manifest is generated.
findings.minimum_fix: Seal the manifest hash and include the completion marker or a final receipt in the first-layer manifest.

Formality proves implementation equivalence, not the cycle-speedup fairness or memory model.
